comment: CI shard map for the e2e job (parallel: 9). Each entry lists the feature FILES one shard runs (comma-separated, relative to the codecept dir, consumed via TASK_CODECEPTJS_FEATURES); check:shard-coverage enforces that every feature file lands in exactly one shard. Balanced on measured CI durations: the long single stories ride alone (1, 2) and bound the pipeline wall-clock; the MegaLinter-hungry pair shares shard 7 so its image pull is paid once and both run concurrently. Shard 9 groups the two runner-driven stories — @daily-contribution (an everyday change rides an MR and main releases it, two full pipelines) and @release-window (a real release pipeline is aborted mid-push, one partial pipeline cancelled early) — because both register a project-scoped runner on the shared gitlab-runner service; running them in one job keeps every other shard free of a runner.
